:::{#def-identity-matrix}
#### Identity matrix

The $p \times p$ **identity matrix** $\matr{I}_p$
(or $\matr{I}$ when the size is clear from context)
has ones on the [main diagonal](#def-main-diagonal) and zeros elsewhere:

$$
(\matr{I}_p)_{ij} =
\begin{cases}
1 & \text{if } i = j \\
0 & \text{if } i \neq j
\end{cases}
\qquad
\matr{I}_p =
\begin{bmatrix}
1      & 0      & \cdots & 0      \\
0      & 1      & \cdots & 0      \\
\vdots & \vdots & \ddots & \vdots \\
0      & 0      & \cdots & 1
\end{bmatrix}
$$

Equivalently,
the entries of the identity matrix are given by the
[Kronecker delta](notation.qmd#def-kronecker-delta):
$(\matr{I}_p)_{ij} = \kron_{ij}$.

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#exm-identity-matrix}
#### The $3 \times 3$ identity

$$
\matr{I}_3 = \begin{bmatrix} 1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 \end{bmatrix},
$$

so, for instance, $(\matr{I}_3)_{22} = 1$ and $(\matr{I}_3)_{23} = 0$.

:::
